description.zh:
监播输出流的App。
名称可自取，不传默认用**monitor**作为AppName名称。
description.en: The application name for the output stream of the monitoring session. You can specify a custom name. If you do not specify this parameter, **monitor** is used as the application name.

description.zh: 支持输入HTTP(S)格式的回调地址。
description.en: The webhook address. HTTP and HTTPS are supported.

description.zh:
监播钉钉告警通过钉群机器人进行告警信息的通知，请先设置钉群机器人，并在此输入机器人的HTTP(S)地址。详情请参见[自定义机器人接入](https://open.dingtalk.com/document/robots/custom-robot-access)。

> 配置钉群机器人自定义关键词为“告警”，否则消息无法接收。
description.en:
The webhook URL of the DingTalk chatbot. To receive alert notifications, configure a DingTalk chatbot and enter its webhook URL, which can be in HTTP or HTTPS format. For more information, see [Custom robot access](https://open.dingtalk.com/document/robots/custom-robot-access).

> Set the custom keyword for the DingTalk chatbot to "Alerting". Otherwise, you cannot receive messages.

description.zh: 监控流输入列表。具体内容，请参考下表**InputConfig**。
description.en: The list of input streams to monitor. For more information, see the **InputConfig** table below.

description.zh: 监播告警阈值设置，JSON格式，具体内容，请参考下表MonitorConfig。
description.en: The alert threshold settings for monitoring. The value must be a JSON string. For more information, see the MonitorConfig table below.
The name of the monitoring session.

description.zh:
监播输出模版。类型取值：

- **lp_ld**：流畅。
- **lp_sd**：标清。
- **lp_hd**：高清。
- **lp_ud**：超清。
description.en:
The output template for the monitoring session. Valid values:

- **lp\_ld**: low definition.

- **lp\_sd**: standard definition.

- **lp\_hd**: high definition.

- **lp\_ud**: ultra-high definition.

description.zh: 监播输出流名，不传则系统随机生成。
description.en: The name of the output stream for the monitoring session. If you do not specify this parameter, the system generates a random name.

descriptions.zh:
调用本接口创建监播室，调用时请保证参数设置符合要求。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
Call this operation to create a monitoring session. Ensure that the required parameters are configured.

## QPS limit

The queries per second (QPS) limit for a single user is 10 calls per second. If you exceed the limit, your API calls are throttled. This may affect your business. Plan your API calls accordingly.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live create-live-stream-monitor --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --monitor-name liveMonitor0000 --output-template lp_ud --domain demo.aliyundoc.com --app monitor0000 --stream monitorStream0000 --input-list InputConfig --monitor-config fpsLowThres_:_0.6,_brLowThres_:_1.1,_eofDurationThresSec_:_10 --callback-url http://guide.aliyundoc.com/notify --ding-talk-web-hook-url https://oapi.dingtalk.com/robot/send0access_token=7a7d404056eee1f2fd944ace9bcfc361dc6448583e1d3d3baa0000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live CreateLiveStreamMonitor --region cn-hangzhou --App monitor0000 --CallbackUrl 'http://guide.aliyundoc.com/notify' --OutputTemplate lp_ud --InputList InputConfig --DingTalkWebHookUrl 'https://oapi.dingtalk.com/robot/send0access_token=7a7d404056eee1f2fd944ace9bcfc361dc6448583e1d3d3baa0000' --MonitorName liveMonitor0000 --Stream monitorStream0000 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Domain 'demo.aliyundoc.com' --MonitorConfig 'fpsLowThres_:_0.6,_brLowThres_:_1.1,_eofDurationThresSec_:_10'
